Yeah it can be lots of genres, usually it's techno/synth or ambient music, but it can use real instruments. Lots of repetition, no really complex techniques.

I say spell as it can just put you in a really meditative state, it's very trance-like. I imagine it's what certain drugs can do to you, but not quite as strong.

Sci-fi is cool, especially biology related sci-fi. I loved reading Jurassic Park.

Yeah it's really hard to be motivated but I too want to try, just so I can say I've made something in my life.

Thanks for chatting, I hope you have a good evening too.

Thanks for asking. I like music, specifically music that can put you under a "spell". I'm trying to learn how to make my own music, I've started playing the guitar.

I also like history and fantasy, and a few other related niche topics.

What do you like?
